Name: Animated Lunna - Astray Fish
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Animated Lunna - Astray Fish[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/u][/b][size=3]Adds animations to the 5 fish added by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray [/url]mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516?tab=user+files]Rafseazz[/url]. I did rotate some of the sprites to make it more compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6516]Happy Fish Jump[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2920064?tab=user+files]Sakorona[/url]. 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/afBL6LR.gif[/img][/center][/size][u][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- and [size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray [/url]﻿(and of course the mods required to run that)[/size]

[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i][size=3]config.json[/size][/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i][size=3]content.json[/size][/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.
Run the game once to generate the config.json.
[/size][/size][/size]
[u][size=5][b]Extra[/b]
[/size][/u][size=3]Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5735]Animated Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6089]Animated Fish SVE[/url]﻿,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish, [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11949]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10913]Animated East Scarp Fish[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5845]Animated More New Fish[/url].[/size]
